footsteps.description: Four soft, padded, cartoonish footstep sounds, like walking on a carpet.

tiptoe.description: A rapid, high-pitched mechanical ringing sound, like an old-fashioned telephone or alarm clock.

slide.description: A fast, rattling clatter, like a wooden stick dragged quickly across a ridged surface or washboard.

thud.description: A very soft, gentle, and muffled thud, like a light object dropping onto a padded surface.

boing.description: A single, soft, gentle, and warm cartoon boing sound effect at a low volume.

pop.description: A single, soft, and cute cartoon bubble pop sound.

whoosh.description: A gentle, soft, airy whoosh sound, resembling a small toy or object swiping through the air.

sparkle.description: A soft, magical twinkling chime sound, like fairy dust or a magic wand sparkling.

tada.description: Three bright, cheerful, rising notes played on a soft glockenspiel or xylophone, creating a success jingle.

oh_no.description: A gentle, descending two-note marimba melody resembling a cute 'uh-oh' sound.

question.description: A soft, rising two-note xylophone melody conveying a curious, questioning tone.

idea.description: A bright, soft, single bell ding, resembling a classic cartoon light bulb idea moment.

clap.description: Four quick, gentle hand claps. Soft and playful, fitting well for a toddler cartoon.

hug.description: Soft fabric rustling followed by a gentle, magical harp shimmer. Very soothing and cozy.

munch.description: Three distinct, crisp, and soft crunching sounds, exactly like someone taking small bites of an apple.

rustle.description: A soft, gentle rustling sound of leaves and grass moving lightly in the breeze.

ball.description: Three gentle, rhythmic thuds of a soft rubber ball bouncing on a wooden surface.

heart.description: A sweet, ascending, magical harp and chime glissando that sounds warm and loving.

squeak_happy.description: A single, short, high-pitched, and cute squeak, like a cartoon baby hamster.

chirp_happy.description: A single, soft, high-pitched, and sweet chirp resembling a happy baby bird.

purr.description: A soft, rhythmic, and gentle purring sound of a cat or kitten.

coo.description: A soft, gentle, high-pitched cooing or whining sound, resembling a baby dove or small animal.

yawn_soft.description: A soft, gentle, high-pitched vocal sigh or yawn, sounding like a sleepy cute cartoon character.

giggle_toy.description: A single, short, high-pitched squeak, like a rubber duck or small squeaky toy being squeezed.

pluck.description: A single, soft, playful pizzicato string pluck.
